note: The daily-bar price feed and the live intraday quote feed disagree by a full session this run (bars dated 2026-07-23 vs live Alpaca quotes at 17:21 UTC today) with no flag in the bundle calling this out explicitly — I had to cross-reference price_freshness.prices_meta_sample against universe_scan.indicators_by_ticker by hand to notice MU had already moved ~12% intraday on real news that the RSI/ADX/MACD fields in the bundle do not reflect. A deterministic check that compares indicators_by_ticker[T].price_as_of against the live overlay date and stamps a per-ticker `stale_technicals` flag when they diverge by more than one session would save this cross-referencing every time the yfinance feed is blocked.
